hook.name: V22Hook
hook.description: A launchpad hook that charges fees as hook return deltas on the pool's numeraire leg (static LP fee is zero). Fees combine a base rate, an optional per-pool creator tax (0–10%), and a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys only; an optional NFT holder gate restricts buying to collection holders during an early window. Liquidity is locked via a burned PositionManager NFT; removals and donations revert.
